verdict.rationale: The workers-sdk ships a workerd-powered simulator for developing and testing Workers locally, and API tokens can be scoped to specific resources, which limits what an agent can reach. Neither source explicitly says that local or test runs use data separate from production. missing for 10: explicit docs that local/simulated bindings (KV, D1, R2) are isolated from production data, documented staging/preview environments, independent or hands-on corroboration of safe sandboxed testing.
